title: Jde cnc consultant
description:
About Us:
Redfaire is a growing, international technology company headquartered in Limerick, Ireland. Redfaire helps global organisations modernise their JD Edwards environments, migrate to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and unlock value through automation, analytics, and innovation.
Innovation is at the heart of everything at Redfaire, we provide guidance and expertise to our customers in Oracle Cloud, Integrations, AI and Machine Learning.
Headquartered in Limerick, Ireland, we also have offices in UK and USA and a direct presence in other international locations. As a founding partner of Redfaire International, a global network of top-tier JD Edwards consultancies, we’re able to deliver even broader, more impactful solutions to our clients worldwide.
About the Role:
We are currently recruiting a CNC Consultant to join our busy Technical Services Team. The CNC Consultant is responsible for the installation and configuration of JD Edwards Enterprise One, including environment setup, user access, security, distributed processing, and version control, as well as testing CNC configurations and controlling software deployment throughout the organisation.
The candidate should have excellent verbal & written communication skills in English & proven analytical and problem-solving skills. The candidate will also need the ability to work in a remote team environment.
Due to the requirement to support our clients in specific time zones, we are seeking appointment of candidates within the Lat Am Region.
Responsibilities:
The CNC Consultant role is extremely broad, and responsibilities include (but are not limited to);
Oracle ERP (JD Edwards) System Administration, which includes Server and Application Administration, ERP Security Management at user and role level.
Planning and installation of business application patches also called electronic software updates or ESUs as well as underlying foundational code or programs called tools releases or service packs
Building and deploying changes to the business applications via package management.
Management of various business environments & path codes like development, user acceptance testing (UAT) and production, making sure each environment has relevant privileges for users to work with objects in OMW along with required OCM Mapping and Datasources.
Ability to Setup and Troubleshoot Printer configuration within JDE, Transform and Print Server
Server Manager (the Tools Release 9.1 and above) system management console advance skills.
Performance tuning of applications and web servers using Server Manager to analyze kernel processes and obtain log files for detailed analysis.
Basic system auditing and performance tuning tasks.
Development of software tools and processes to automate repetitive CNC tasks
Refreshing and optimization of the underlying database, working with database administrators
Experience/expertise with SQL databases such as Oracle, SQL Server with regards to Enterprise One
Adherence to Redfaire and client Data Protection policies.
Qualifications & Skills:

Technical Experience: Minimum 6-7 Years of JDE CNC experience.
Expertise in the technical architecture for Enterprise One (e.g. Citrix servers, Web Logic servers, Web Sphere servers, deployment server, batch/enterprise servers, BSSV servers, mobile apps/AIS servers plus multiple OS's including Windows, Unix/Linux & AS400 can be advantageous)
Experience in adding custom environments and custom datasource setups
Knowledge of CNC mapping configuration changes using Object Configuration Manager (OCM)
Expertise in multiple JDE system software configurations (multi-foundation), Tools Release Updates
Relevant 3rd level qualification or equivalent.
Excellent communication skills, both verbal & written.
Technical competence with proven analytical skills.
Problem solving and trouble shooting skills (which requires a wide range of skills beyond JDE CNC skills such as networking, storage, database, operating system, and virtual infrastructures and the ability to work with people who are experts in these areas)
Systematic approach to problem resolution.
Ability to work independently under one’s own initiative whilst being part of a global team.
Proven ability to be adaptable and to respond to constantly changing demands.
Ability to work under pressure & to prioritize.
Recognise the importance of customer service and strive to deliver high standards.
Working knowledge of Microsoft products such as Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook.
What we offer:
Career growth within an expanding global award-winning Oracle Partner recognised for excellence.
Supportive team culture with ongoing training and mentorship.
Competitive salary and benefits package.
Opportunity to engage in flexible working arrangements, including remote options, to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance. Redfaire is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to building an integrative culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. Our inclusive workplace provides an environment that will support your development no matter your gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

Job Title: Performance Video Editor & Ad Designer
About the Company:
Our Client is a dynamic organization focused on creating high-conversion advertising content for a variety of social media platforms. They prioritize direct-response advertising and are dedicated to optimizing creative strategies to improve ad performance.

• Excellent typography skills, including text hierarchy, readability, spacing, and composition.
• Comfortable producing creative at volume without sacrificing quality.
• Proficiency in tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Premiere, Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, or similar.
• Strong attention to detail with the ability to follow best practices and legal guidelines while exploring new creative directions.
• Ability to take direction, implement feedback quickly, and meet deadlines.
Preferred Skills:
• Experience with direct-response formats and UGC-style editing.
• Familiarity with before/after iterations or creative variations.
Personality:
• Creative thinker with a keen eye for detail.
• Adaptable and open to feedback and new ideas.
• Strong communicator with the ability to work well under pressure.
Software & Tools:
• Adobe Creative Suite

title: Border patrol agent
description: February 2026 Update GL-5/7 grade levelsBorder Patrol Agent (BPA) - in the Federal Security and Public Safety Sector (Entry Level)A MISSION WORTHY OF A CAREERIf you're looking for "just a job," then stop reading right now. But, if you're looking for a long-term federal law enforcement career, one that makes a difference every day to our country and its citizens, then the U. S. Border Patrol (USBP) would like you to take the first step to becoming an entry level Border Patrol Agent.USBP is hiring immediately to fill full-time, entry-level, career positions in federal law enforcement where your prior experience in public safety, security, military police or law enforcement may qualify. Train and work with an elite team of professionals whose camaraderie, pride, and sense of purpose are hallmarks of their daily mission of protecting America.Now is the time to make your move because, along with excellent base pay, exceptional benefits, and job stability, USBP is offering up to $60,000 in additional incentives (see details below).Salary and BenefitsAnnual base salary for newly appointed BPAs varies per grade, as follows: GL-5/GL-7 $51,632 - $92,219 per year. Border Patrol Agents are eligible to select from an array of federal employment benefits that include health, dental and other insurance plans, a generous annual and sick leave program, and participation in the Thrift Savings Plan, a retirement plan akin to a traditional ROTH 401(k) offering.*Recruitment Incentive* Newly appointed Border Patrol Agents (as defined in 5 CFR 575.102 ( ) will be eligible for up to $20,000 in incentives. The first $10,000 will be paid upon successful completion of the Border Patrol Academy, with the remaining $10,000 awarded for accepting a prioritized location such as Sierra Blanca, Presidio, Sanderson, Comstock, Freer or Hebbronville, TX; Lordsburg, NM; or Ajo, AZ.*Retention Incentive* Newly appointed Border Patrol Agents may also qualify for up to $40,000 in additional incentives distributed over their first four years.Duty LocationsIMPORTANT NOTICED: Duty assignments available at the time of offer may include the Southwest Border, including prioritized locations.U. S. Border Patrol determines duty assignments at the time of offer based on operational needs, which may or may not align with candidates' first-choice preferences. RELOCATION MAY BE REQUIRED.Duty location impacts pay rates; locality pay for federal law enforcement is higher in some locations than others. A fully trained BPA may be eligible for up to an additional 25% of base pay per the BPA Pay Reform Act of 2014. This is a career ladder position with a grade level progression of GL-5, GL-7, GL-9, GS-11, and GS-12. You will be eligible for a promotion to the next higher grade level (without reapplying) once you successfully complete 52 weeks in each grade level.Duty Locations: You will be asked to select your preferred location for one of the following mission critical locations:>* Big Bend Sector Stations - *Presidio, Van Horn, *Sanderson, Alpine, *Sierra Blanca, Marfa* Buffalo Sector Stations - Wellesley Island* Del Rio Sector Stations - Del Rio, Brackettville, *Comstock, Eagle Pass North, Eagle Pass South, Carrizo Springs, Uvalde* El Paso Sector Stations - Alamogordo, Clint, Deming, El Paso, Fort Hancock, Las Cruces, *Lordsburg, Santa Teresa, Ysleta* El Centro Sector Stations - El Centro, Indio, Calexico* Grand Forks Sector Stations - Pembina* Havre Sector Stations - Havre, Malta, Plentywood, Scobey, Sweetgrass* Houlton Sector Stations - Calais, Fort Fairfield, Jackman, Rangeley, Van Buren* Laredo Sector Stations - Laredo South, Cotulla, *Hebbronville, Laredo West, *Freer, Laredo North, Zapata* Rio Grande Valley Sector Stations - Rio Grande City, Fort Brown, Mc Allen, Brownsville, Falfurrias, Weslaco, Kingsville, Harlingen* San Diego Sector Stations - Boulevard, Brownfield, Campo, Chula Vista, Imperial Beach, Murrieta, San Clemente* Spokane Sector Stations - Colville, Curlew, Metaline Falls, Oroville* Swanton Sector Stations - Beecher Falls, Burke, Champlain, Newport, Richford* Tucson Sector Stations - *Ajo, Tucson, Nogales, Douglas, Brian A Terry, Sonoita, Casa Grande, Three Points Substation, Willcox* Yuma Sector Stations - Blythe, Yuma, WelltonDuties and ResponsibilitiesAs a BPA, you will be part of our 60,000+ workforce that strives to protect the American people by safeguarding our borders, deterring illicit activity, and enhancing the nation's economic prosperity. Being a BPA makes you a valuable member of the Federal Law Enforcement Officer (LEO) profession.Typical assignments include:* Detecting and questioning people suspected of violating immigration and custom laws and inspecting documents and possessions to determine citizenship or violations* Preventing and apprehending undocumented noncitizens and smugglers of noncitizens at or near the borders by maintaining surveillance from covert positions to include using infrared scopes during night operations* Interpreting and following tracks, marks, and other physical evidence of illegal entry of persons or contraband* Performing farm checks, building checks, traffic checks, city patrols, and transportation checks* Patrolling the international boundary and coastal waterways using a variety of government assets such as vehicles, horses, vessels, watercraft, off-road vehicles, ATVs, snowmobiles, and motorcycles for the accomplishment of the USBP Mission.QualificationsYou qualify for the GL-5 grade level if you possess one of the following:Experience: One (1) year of general work experience that demonstrates the ability to take charge, make sound decisions, and maintain composure in stressful situations; to learn regulations, methods, and techniques through classroom training and/or on-the-job instruction; and the ability to gather concise information through questioning, observation, and examination of documents and records; OREducation Substitution: A bachelor's degree or successful completion of a full four-year course of study in any field leading to a bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university; ORCombination of Experience and Education: A combination of general work experience AND successfully completed college education. This will be calculated using your resume and official or unofficial transcripts submitted with your application.You qualify for the GL-7 grade level if you possess one of the following:Experience: One year of specialized work experience that shows you have the skills necessary to:* Make sound judgments and decisions in the use of firearms.* Deal effectively with people in a courteous and tactful manner in connection with law enforcement matters.* Analyze information rapidly and make prompt decisions where you will be expected to make arrests after the completion of required training and apply these skills in a law enforcement capacity such as criminal code enforcement, determining violations of laws, correctional or rehabilitation work involving criminal offenders, security, military, etc.The above experience will be applied in connection with the following: Make arrests and exercise sound judgment in the use of firearms; deal effectively with people in a courteous manner in connection with law enforcement matters; analyze information rapidly and make prompt decisions; or develop and maintain contact with a network of informants.Education Substitution for the GL-7 grade level: A bachelor's degree with superior academic achievement, which is based on (1) class standing, (2) grade-point average (i.e., GPA of 3.0 or higher out of a possible 4.0), or (3) honor society membership. Or will receive a bachelor's degree with Superior Academic Achievement. Or one full year of graduate-level education in a field of study related to law enforcement (e.g., criminal justice, homeland security, justice studies, law enforcement, courts and judicial systems, forensic technology, forensic psychology, or corrections and rehabilitation) from an accredited college or university; ORA Combination of Experience and Education: This will be calculated using your resume and official or unofficial transcripts submitted with your application.Note: If you have previous or current law enforcement or military law enforcement experience, you may qualify at the GL-9 and or GS-11 grade level. Please refer to the BPA GL-9 - 11 announcement.Other RequirementsCitizenship: You must be a U. S. Citizen to apply for this position.Residency: You must have had primary U. S. residency (includes protectorates as declared under international law) for at least three of the last five years.Age Restriction: In accordance with Public Law 100-238, this position is covered under law enforcement retirement provisions. Candidates must be referred for selection to the Border Patrol Agent position before reaching their 40th birthday in accordance with Department of Homeland Security Directive 251-03. The age restriction may not apply if you are currently serving or have previously served in a federal civilian law enforcement (non-military) position covered by Title 5 U. S. C. 8336(c) or Title 5 U. S. C. 8412(d).Veterans' Preference: You may also be eligible for an excepted service Veterans Recruitment Appointment (VRA). The age restriction does not apply if you are Veterans' Preference eligible.Formal Training: After you are hired, you will be detailed to the U. S. Border Patrol Academy in Artesia, New Mexico, for approximately six (6) months of intensive instruction in immigration and nationality laws, law enforcement and USBP-specific operations, driver training, physical techniques, firearms, and other courses. Border Patrol work requires the ability to speak and read Spanish, as well as English. Border Patrol Agents will be provided training to become proficient with the Spanish language at the Academy.How to Apply:Click the Apply button on this site. You will be linked to the CBP Talent Network registration page. For Position of Interest, select Border Patrol Agent, then complete the pre-screening questions.You'll then receive a link(s) to the BPA Job Opening Announcements (JOAs) on USAJOBS, the federal government's official employment site, to complete your application. Be certain to review ALL details of the job opportunity announcement and follow all instructions in the application process, including items (resume, transcripts, etc.) to submit. You will be evaluated based on your resume, supporting documents, and the BPA Entrance Exam.If you have questions about the application process, contact a recruiter through the U. S. Border Patrol page: careers.cbp.gov/s/usbp.As a subscriber to the CBP Talent Network, you'll receive monthly emails with information about webinars, career expos, and future opportunities with CBP.

description:

The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer API standards and architectural guidelines.Responsibilities
Adopt an API Design First Approach: Leverage Open API (Swagger), RAML, or Async API specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
API Specification Creation: Design API specifications that adhere to Sodexo's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
Policy Design and Configuration: Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
Mock API Development: Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
API Testing: Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
Environment Configuration: Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
API Deployment: Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API Dev Ops framework.
Documentation: Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
Metadata Publishing: Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.API Consumer Onboarding
Secure Authentication Setup: Configure OAuth/Open ID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
Subscription Key Management: Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
Integration Testing Support: Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.Testing & Validation
Functional Testing: Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
Mock and Staging Environment Management: Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.Skills and Expertise
API Design First Expertise: Proficient in designing APIs using Open API, Swagger Hub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
Azure API Management: Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
Security Standards: Strong knowledge of OAuth2, Open ID Connect, and API key management best practices.
Documentation Excellence: Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
Testing Proficiency: Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman toolWhat can you expect from us?• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

Atuar no campo como protagonista da estratégia comercial, conectando conhecimento técnico, relacionamento e geração de valor para agricultores e parceiros, impulsionando o crescimento do negócio em soluções biológicas.

Atuar de forma colaborativa com os times técnico, marketing e liderança comercial.

Graduação em Agronomia, Engenharia Agronômica, agronegocio, Administração ou áreas correlatas (preferencialmente com CREA ativo). Desejável pós-graduação em Ciência de Cultivos, Nutrição de Plantas, Proteção de Cultivos ou áreas afins.

Atuação dinâmica, com presença frequente em campo, relacionamento próximo com agricultores e viagens regulares dentro da região de atuação.

Sementes:Rondonópolis/MT, Rio Verde/GO e Londrina/PR

description:

Mandatory Skills Description:

Product & Delivery Execution

Hands-on experience with backlog management, refinement, and sprint execution

Quality & Compliance Mindset

Strong attention to detail and traceability (requirements → implementation → validation)
Ability to manage high-risk changes where small defects can have large impact
Release & Operational Skills
Experience coordinating software releases end to end
Ability to track release readiness, risks, and regressions
Comfort working with production or preproduction environments (e.g. test benches)
Tools & Ways of Working
Experience working with distributed or nearshore teams
Strong hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence
Solid understanding of agile software development (Scrum, SAFe)
Ability to operate independently with limited guidance
Stakeholder & Pressure Handling
Proven ability to work with hands-off stakeholders who escalate under failure
Strong communication skills: clear, calm, and structured under pressure
Ability to anticipate issues, surface risks early, and drive resolution
Good judgment in knowing when to act independently vs when to escalate
Project Description:

This role coordinates delivery and releases for an in-car accessibility product within an Android-based infotainment system, with a primary focus on meeting legal and regulatory accessibility requirements.
Core responsibilities include ensuring compliance, traceability, and correct implementation of accessibility-related changes, while driving quality improvements, defect resolution, and predictable, disciplined releases. Occasional support for new feature development is also expected.
Due to the nature of accessibility work, even small changes can have significant user and legal impact, making precision, validation, and strong execution essential. The role operates in a highly complex stakeholder environment, where stakeholders are typically hands-off during day-to-day execution but become highly involved and escalatory when issues arise. Successfully navigating these situations—through transparency, risk anticipation, sound judgment, and resolution under pressure—is a critical aspect of the role.
The role works closely with a small team of Android developers. The exact split of responsibilities will be defined once the new hire is onboarded, allowing flexibility based on individual strengths, experience, and evolving product and delivery needs.
Responsibilities:

Product & Backlog Management
Manage and maintain the product backlog in Jira, with a primary focus on accessibility-related bug
fixes, improvements, and release work
Support new accessibility features by preparing, refining, and tracking requirements and acceptance
criteria with stakeholder
Clarify functional, UX, and accessibility requirements with stakeholders and engineering
Ensure backlog items are well-defined, testable, and ready for implementation
Sprint, PI & Delivery Execution
Plan and facilitate sprint and PI activities with the development team
Coordinate sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and execution tracking
Monitor progress, dependencies, and risks across sprints and PIs
Sequence and balance work within agreed priorities and constraints to support timely delivery
Accessibility, Quality & Change Coordination
Coordinate defect fixes, accessibility improvements, and change requests
Assess and document impacts, dependencies, and delivery risks, especially where accessibility or
compliance may be affected
Highlight trade-offs and potential impacts early and transparently
Escalate complex or high-impact topics to the appropriate stakeholders
Release & Operational Ownership
Coordinate end-to-end release activities, including readiness tracking, validation status, and
communication
Support CI/CD, build, test, and deployment processes in collaboration with engineering
Track release quality, regression risks, and production issues
Coordinate verification activities on test benches and organize debugging sessions when required
Management of test specifications (update existing test specifications if required, create test runs for
external testers, etc.)
Stakeholder Communication
Represent the team and topic in stakeholder meetings, like calls with VW Group brands or
representatives of legal and regulatory departments
Act as the primary coordination point for day-to-day delivery and release topics
Communicate progress, risks, and release status clearly and consistently
Support alignment between product, UX, engineering, and validation stakeholders

title: Especialista fiscal (erp)
description:
Nós da Odoo acreditamos que softwares para gerenciar negócios devem cobrir necessidades complexas sem serem complicados. Somos um conjunto de aplicativos de negócios em código aberto que cobre todas as necessidades das pequenas e médias empresas: CRM, e-commerce, contabilidade, estoque… Ajudamos empresas a se tornarem mais eficientes, gastando menos!
Aqui na Odoo, Especialistas Fiscais são pessoas colaborativas, orientadas para resultados, com visão analítica e paixão por tecnologia. São responsáveis por garantir o sucesso da Localização Brasileira no nosso software, implementando seus módulos e atuando em contato direto com os clientes para assegurar a conformidade com as legislações fiscais e tributárias.
Para isso, você será a linha de frente, analisando as necessidades dos clientes, projetando a solução, configurando os fluxos fiscais, e fornecendo sessões de treinamento . Sua atuação é crucial para garantir que os projetos sejam entregues dentro do prazo e do orçamento, além de ser um ponto importante de apoio para o time de P. O. de Localização Brasileira.
Também será responsável por manter atualizada a nossa base de conhecimento dos fluxos de localização brasileira, facilitando a autonomia do cliente após a implementação.
Basicamente, você será responsável por fornecer a melhor solução de gerenciamento fiscal/contábil aos seus clientes, prestando suporte interno com as demandas fiscais e tributárias necessárias para facilitar os negócios dos nossos clientes, apoiando PMEs de diversos setores a extrair o máximo valor da Odoo. Atuamos com foco no usuário, de maneira ágil, dinâmica e sempre pensando no longo prazo.
Responsabilidades e dia a dia:
Gerenciar o relacionamento com os clientes durante a implementação do Odoo.
Analisar as necessidades do cliente e os requisitos fiscais e contábeis.
Prestar apoio para time interno de Analistas de Negócios e Time Comercial com dúvidas e validações contábeis/fiscais.
Garantir que os projetos estão em conformidade com as fundamentações fiscais corretas através da operacionalização no Portal Avalara (será treinado).
Atuará com implementação de projetos compreendendo a nova reforma tributária a partir de 2026.
Documentar os cenários de validação fiscal dos projetos, gerar relatórios e documentações dos fluxos fiscais para documentação interna e documentação de cliente.
Atuar diretamente em contato com o P. O. do produto de Localização Brasileira para apoiar em especificações técnicas e testes de funcionalidades e bugfixes.

title: Bolsista doutores inovando no setor empresarial - natosafe - pesquisa de ia generativa
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.
O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.
Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .
Sobre a Oportunidade:
A Natosafe é pioneira em biometria infantil, comprometidos em preencher a lacuna existente na proteção, segurança e garantia de identidade para as crianças. Durante anos, essa questão crucial tem sido negligenciada, deixando os mais vulneráveis expostos a riscos e sem o reconhecimento adequado. Através da coleta de biometria desde os primeiros momentos de vida, asseguramos que cada criança tenha sua identidade e cidadania protegidas, contribuindo para um futuro mais seguro e inclusivo, onde todas as crianças sejam vistas, cuidadas, respeitadas e tenham pleno acesso aos seus direitos desde o nascimento.
O projeto visa melhorar a qualificação de imagens e a extração de características das impressões digitais, além de permitir o reconhecimento de indivíduos ao longo do tempo, considerando as variações naturais nas características digitais.
Formação Acadêmica:
Doutorado completo nas áreas de Ciência da Computação.
Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.
Projeto: Pesquisa da IA Generativa voltada à imagens de impressões digitais de crianças

Principais Atividades:
Pesquisa Avançada: Conduzir pesquisas inovadoras em computação quântica aplicadas a sistemas de segurança digital e autenticação biométrica. Explorar novos algoritmos quânticos e suas aplicações práticas na criação de soluções mais robustas e seguras.
Desenvolvimento de Soluções: Desenvolver novos modelos de autenticação que utilizem a computação quântica para criar sistemas mais seguros, adaptáveis e imunes a ataques sofisticados.
Disseminação do Conhecimento: Participar de conferências e eventos acadêmicos, apresentando descobertas, novas teorias e inovações tecnológicas. Contribuir para a construção de um ecossistema de pesquisa em computação quântica no Brasil e globalmente.
Apoio à Implementação de Tecnologias: Auxiliar na transição das descobertas teóricas para a prática, facilitando a implementação de novas tecnologias de segurança digital em ambientes reais, tanto no contexto acadêmico quanto em colaboração com empresas de tecnologia.
Conhecimento necessário:
Visão Computacional Avançada
Processamento de Sinais e Imagens Digitais
Aplicação de redes neurais convolucionais (CNNs)
Projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação
Programação em Python e C++ com uso de bibliotecas como Open CV, Tensor Flow, Py Torch
Atuação com frameworks para prototipagem rápida em visão computacional.
Inglês Avançado. Conhecimento desejável:
Programação Quântica: Proficiência em linguagens de programação voltadas para computação quântica, como Qiskit (IBM) e Cirq (Google), além de Python e outras linguagens tradicionais. A capacidade de programar em ambientes quânticos será fundamental para o desenvolvimento de soluções escaláveis e seguras.
Algoritmos Quânticos: Conhecimento avançado na criação, implementação e otimização de algoritmos quânticos, com foco em criptografia quântica e autenticação biométrica. Deve possuir a capacidade de aplicar teoria quântica para criar soluções robustas de segurança digital.
Criptografia Quântica: Expertise em criptografia quântica para desenvolver sistemas imunes a ataques futuros, utilizando princípios da física quântica para garantir a segurança da verificação de identidade.
Desejável: Conhecimento de algoritmos biométricos e sistemas de verificação de identidade, além de familiaridade com técnicas de deep learning e machine learning aplicadas à biometria.
Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial
Formato de trabalho : Híbrido
Local: Curitiba/PR
Soft Skills : Trabalho em equipe; Autonomia; Organização.

About the roleSkyflow is a data privacy vault delivered via APIs. It helps companies isolate, protect, govern, and use sensitive data such as personal, health, or payment information securely, without losing usability. It’s built on a zero-trust architecture, meaning no one gets access to data unless explicitly allowed.

title: Border patrol agent - earn up to 30,000 in recruitment incentives
description: Border Patrol Agent (BPA) Entry LevelNEW RECRUITMENT AND RETENTION INCENTIVESIMPORTANT NOTICE : Duty assignments available at the time of offer may include the Southwest Border, including prioritized locations.U. S. Border Patrol determines duty assignments at the time of offer based on operational needs, which may or may not align with candidates' first-choice preferences. Relocation may be required.DON'T FORGET TO CHECK OUT THE INCENTIVES - SEE SALARY SECTION BELOWThe U. S. Border Patrol (USBP) offers those interested in a career in law enforcement an opportunity to work with an elite team of highly trained professionals whose camaraderie, pride, and purpose are hallmarks of their daily mission of protecting America.If you seek an exciting and rewarding job that provides excellent pay, exceptional federal benefits, and job stability, now is the time to make your move. U. S. Border Patrol (USBP), within the U. S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), is hiring immediately for these full-time, entry-level, career Law Enforcement Officer (LEO) opportunities.Salary and BenefitsAnnual Base Salary for newly appointed BPAs varies per grade, as follows:GL-5/GL-7 $49,739 - $89,518 per yearDuty location impacts pay rates; locality pay for federal law enforcement is higher in some locations than others. A fully trained BPA may be eligible for up to an additional 25% of base pay per the BPA Pay Reform Act of 2014. This is a career ladder position with a grade level progression of GL-5, GL-7, GL-9, GS-11, and GS-12. You will be eligible for a promotion to the next higher grade level (without reapplying) once you successfully complete 52 weeks in each grade level.Border Patrol Agents are eligible to select from an array of federal employment benefits that include health, dental and other insurance plans, a generous annual and sick leave program, and participation in the Thrift Savings Plan, a retirement plan akin to a traditional ROTH 401(k) offering.*Recruitment Incentive* Newly appointed Border Patrol Agents (as defined in 5 CFR 575.102 ( ) will be offered up to a $20,000 incentive. The first $10,000 will be paid upon successful completion of the Border Patrol Academy, with the remaining $10,000 awarded for accepting a prioritized location. Prioritized locations include Sierra Blanca, TX; Presidio, TX; Sanderson, TX; Comstock, TX; Lordsburg, NM; Freer, TX; Hebbronville, TX; Ajo, AZ.*Retention Incentive* Newly appointed Border Patrol Agents may also qualify for up to $40,000 in additional incentives distributed over their first four years.Duties and ResponsibilitiesAs a BPA, you will be part of our 60,000+ workforce that strives to protect the American people by safeguarding our borders, deterring illicit activity, and enhancing the nation's economic prosperity. Being a BPA makes you a valuable member of the Federal Law Enforcement Officer (LEO) profession.Typical assignments include:* Detecting and questioning people suspected of violating immigration and custom laws and inspecting documents and possessions to determine citizenship or violations* Preventing and apprehending undocumented noncitizens and smugglers of noncitizens at or near the borders by maintaining surveillance from covert positions to include using infrared scopes during night operations* Interpreting and following tracks, marks, and other physical evidence of illegal entry of persons or contraband* Performing farm checks, building checks, traffic checks, city patrols, and transportation checks* Patrolling the international boundary and coastal waterways using a variety of government assets such as vehicles, horses, vessels, watercraft, off-road vehicles, ATVs, snowmobiles, and motorcycles for the accomplishment of the USBP Mission.QualificationsYou qualify for the GL-5 grade level if you possess one of the following:Experience : One (1) year of general work experience that demonstrates the ability to take charge, make sound decisions, and maintain composure in stressful situations; to learn regulations, methods, and techniques through classroom training and/or on-the-job instruction; and the ability to gather concise information through questioning, observation, and examination of documents and records; OREducation Substitution : A bachelor's degree or successful completion of a full four-year course of study in any field leading to a bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university; ORCombination of Experience and Education : A combination of general work experience AND successfully completed college education. This will be calculated using your resume and official or unofficial transcripts submitted with your application.You qualify for the GL-7 grade level if you possess one of the following:Experience : One year of specialized work experience that shows you have the skills necessary to:* Make sound judgments and decisions in the use of firearms.* Deal effectively with people in a courteous and tactful manner in connection with law enforcement matters.* Analyze information rapidly and make prompt decisions where you will be expected to make arrests after the completion of required training and apply these skills in a law enforcement capacity such as criminal code enforcement, determining violations of laws, correctional or rehabilitation work involving criminal offenders, security, military, etc.The above experience will be applied in connection with the following: Make arrests and exercise sound judgment in the use of firearms; deal effectively with people in a courteous manner in connection with law enforcement matters; analyze information rapidly and make prompt decisions; or develop and maintain contact with a network of informants.Education Substitution for the GL-7 grade level : A bachelor's degree with superior academic achievement, which is based on (1) class standing, (2) grade-point average (i.e., GPA of 3.0 or higher out of a possible 4.0), or (3) honor society membership. Or will receive a bachelor's degree with Superior Academic Achievement. Or one full year of graduate-level education in a field of study related to law enforcement (e.g., criminal justice, homeland security, justice studies, law enforcement, courts and judicial systems, forensic technology, forensic psychology, or corrections and rehabilitation) from an accredited college or university; ORA Combination of Experience and Education : This will be calculated using your resume and official or unofficial transcripts submitted with your application.Note : If you have previous or current law enforcement or military law enforcement experience, you may qualify at the GL-9 and or GS-11 grade level. Please refer to the BPA GL-9 - 11 announcement.Other RequirementsCitizenship : You must be a U. S. Citizen to apply for this position.Residency : You must have had primary U. S. residency (includes protectorates as declared under international law) for at least three of the last five years.Age Restrictio n: In accordance with Public Law 100-238, this position is covered under law enforcement retirement provisions. Candidates must be referred for selection to the Border Patrol Agent position before reaching their 40th birthday in accordance with Department of Homeland Security Directive 251-03. The age restriction may not apply if you are currently serving or have previously served in a federal civilian law enforcement (non-military) position covered by Title 5 U. S. C. 8336(c) or Title 5 U. S. C. 8412(d).Veterans' Preference : You may also be eligible for an excepted service Veterans Recruitment Appointment (VRA). The age restriction does not apply if you are Veterans' Preference eligible.Formal Training : After you are hired, you will be detailed to the U. S. Border Patrol Academy in Artesia, New Mexico, for approximately six (6) months of intensive instruction in immigration and nationality laws, law enforcement and USBP-specific operations, driver training, physical techniques, firearms, and other courses. Border Patrol work requires the ability to speak and read Spanish, as well as English. Border Patrol Agents will be provided training to become proficient with the Spanish language at the Academy.How to Apply:Click the Apply button on this site. You will be linked to the CBP Talent Network registration page. For Position of Interest, select Border Patrol Agent, then complete the pre-screening questions.You'll then receive a link(s) to the BPA Job Opening Announcements (JOAs) on USAJOBS, the federal government's official employment site, to complete your application. Be certain to review ALL details of the job opportunity announcement and follow all instructions in the application process, including items (resume, transcripts, etc.) to submit. You will be evaluated based on your resume, supporting documents, and the BPA Entrance Exam.If you have questions about the application process, contact a recruiter through the U. S. Border Patrol page: careers.cbp.gov/s/usbp.As a subscriber to the CBP Talent Network, you'll receive monthly emails with information about webinars, career expos, and future opportunities with CBP.

title: Hr plant manager
description:

The chosen candidate will be responsible to execute HR strategy, deal with recruitment, training, and development processes, managing local trends and needs building the best team in line with budget, guidelines and local labor laws and regulations. The role creates a diverse and inclusive ecosystem by leveraging talent management, succession planning and accurate total rewards for the assigned Plant, acting in full alignment with the leader above as well as the coherent with the organization model and HR policy and guidelines. HR Manager ensures accurate execution of cost analysis in line with guidance and leads HR administration and payroll processes being a unique point of contact for labor industrial relations and disputes at the plant level.
ActivitiesDefines, develops, and implements HR programs and plans on annual basis for the assigned sites in alignment HR Strategy defined by CHRO and in alignment with the HR Corporate directives, industrial plan, and budget.
Manages staff and recruiting processes, implements compensation and reward strategy, and ensures consistency with the organizational model, in full collaboration with the Regional HR, HR Center of Expertise and CHRO.
Analyses the country-specific trends on a regular basis, sharing with regional/corporate actionable inputs and insights and contributing to the definition of sustainable and competitive actions and strategic targets.
Ensures the execution of corporate global and local guidelines and procedures, implements promptly and effectively corrective and preventive actions to ensure full alignment and compliance with local law.
Executes performance management, training, and development program defined by HR Center of Expertise and provides them prompt and accurate feedback to ensure the effective and sustainable roll-out for the sites assigned.
Recruits, develops and retains resources, cultivates high potential talents, enables succession plans.
Plans how to cover replaces/covers vacant local positions, implements job enlargement, rotation, and enrichment in line with legal requirements, procedures, budget, business and organization model, and Company guidelines.
Creates an inclusive environment and adopts and open-door, encourages employees to speak up as key of success.
Provides guidance on HR processes, solves issues in line with legal, HR& Organization and business strategy.
Ensures the employee relationship management respects the relevant legal and Labour contract requirements, development, compensation, and benefit guidelines practices, in adherence with the company governances.
Provides the plant with HR services, including administration, payroll, and industrial relations, collaborating with the HR team and implementing tools and fair labor practices per labor law.
Elaborates and monitors the budget, supervising the related processes at the local level aimed at ensuring cost-effectiveness and company sustainable business growth.
Oversees and keeps HR costs effectiveness under control promptly identifying opportunities to exploit, managing risk appropriately, and setting up a contingency plan to foster HR strategy deployment.
Manages, coaches, and develops assigned staff, ensuring effective talent management and career path
Interacts regularly and effectively communicates and networks with key internal and external stakeholders, to deliver assigned targets as well as to ensure an effective alignment of company objectives and strategic goals.Mandatory Qualifications5 years proven experience gained in Human Resources management and +2 years as HR Plant Manager, within international companies

title: Growth content creator
description:
Procuramos a pessoa que vai fazer a Ad Man ser vista, sentida e entendida
NaAd Man ()estamos construindo algo do zero.
E agora buscamos alguém que nos ajude acontar essa história para o mundo.
Não estamos procurando “mais um designer”.
Estamos procurando alguém queentenda redes sociais, pense emhistórias, amevídeos curtose se empolgue em ver uma marca crescer — ecrescer junto com ela.O que você vai fazer?Criar conteúdo visual para redes sociais (Instagram, Linked In, etc.).
Produzirvídeos curtos(Reels, Shorts, Tik Toks) que comuniquem ideias de forma clara, simples e impactante.
Transformar mensagens complexas em peças visuais que façam sentido em poucos segundos.
Propor ideias, formatos e conceitos (não apenas executar).
Trabalhar lado a lado com founders, marketing e produto para contar a história da Ad Man.Quem estamos procurando?Alguém com experiência emdesign para redes sociaisevídeos curtos.
Que tenha bom olhar estético, senso visual e critério.
Que saibacomunicar mensagens, não apenas criar coisas bonitas.
Que entenda como funciona a atenção nas redes hoje.
Que tenha vontade de aprender, testar, errar e evoluir rápido.
Que se motive com o crescimento de uma startup e queira fazer parte dessa jornada.O que oferecemos?Participar desde cedo do crescimento daAd Man.
Muita autonomia, impacto real e espaço para propor ideias.
Aprendizado direto trabalhando com os founders.
Um projeto com ambição, ritmo de startup e visão de longo prazo.
Crescimento profissional no mesmo ritmo em que a empresa cresce.
﻿
Essa vaga é para você se…Você se importa mais com impacto do que com hierarquia.
Prefere construir algo que está começando do zero em vez de apenas manter algo já pronto.
Quer olhar para trás daqui a alguns anos e dizer:“eu estive desde o começo”.
Se você sentiu que essa vaga fala com você, queremos te conhecer.

title: Compensation & benefits manager
description:
ABOUT COTY
Coty is one of the world's largest beauty companies, with an iconic portfolio of fragrance, color cosmetics, skincare, and body care brands. They celebrate and foster a culture of kindness and pride themselves on offering equal opportunities. Coty believes that beauty is found in diversity and is committed to creating an environment where every talent shines, valuing the unique contributions each individual brings to the team. As part of their commitment to inclusion, all profiles are welcome at Coty.
Join Coty and be part of a dynamic team dedicated to shaping the future of the beauty industry in Latin America through a unique footprint. Apply now to contribute your expertise and passion for technology and to drive digital transformation into our business success!JOB OVERVIEWAs a Compensation & Benefits Manager, you will be responsible for developing, implementing, and managing compensation and benefits programs, as well as leading the respective team, ensuring competitive structures that attract, retain, and engage top talent. You will act proactively and strategically in the design and implementation of solutions, ensuring process optimization, governance, clarity, and effective communication with leaders, HRBPs, and employees. You will ensure that compensation structures and benefits packages are aligned with the organization’s strategic objectives and market best practices.RESPONSIBILITIESDesign and implement global compensation strategies and processes that drive performance and talent retention;
Conduct compensation benchmarking analyses, ensuring alignment with market practices and presenting results to the global team;
Partner with leadership to review, approve, and adjust salary structures as needed;
Develop policies, guidelines, and processes related to compensation and benefits;
Create communication and training materials for leaders, HRBPs, and employees regarding compensation and benefits practices;

Sobre a BRQ Digital
Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.
Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.
BRQ WAY
No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!
É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.
Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.
Ei Gerente de Negócios – UX / Produto Digital, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq
- O que procuramos?
Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Atuar de forma consultiva, identificando oportunidades e elaborando planos estratégicos de negócios alinhados ao portfólio de soluções UI/UX e Mar Tech . Conhecimento em tendências e tecnologias digitais , com capacidade de comunicar benefícios técnicos e comerciais. Vivência em gestão de pipeline de vendas e metas financeiras. Experiência com gestão de produtos .

Mais do que um plano de carreira !
A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:
Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!
Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.
Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.
Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Atuação híbrida; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

description:

Ability to manage high-risk changes where small defects can have large impact
Release & Operational Skills

Tools & Ways of Working

Ability to operate independently with limited guidance
Stakeholder & Pressure Handling
Proven ability to work with hands-off stakeholders who escalate under failure
Strong communication skills: clear, calm, and structured under pressure
Ability to anticipate issues, surface risks early, and drive resolution
Good judgment in knowing when to act independently vs when to escalateProject Description:This role coordinates delivery and releases for an in-car accessibility product within an Android-based infotainment system, with a primary focus on meeting legal and regulatory accessibility requirements.
Core responsibilities include ensuring compliance, traceability, and correct implementation of accessibility-related changes, while driving quality improvements, defect resolution, and predictable, disciplined releases. Occasional support for new feature development is also expected.
Due to the nature of accessibility work, even small changes can have significant user and legal impact, making precision, validation, and strong execution essential. The role operates in a highly complex stakeholder environment, where stakeholders are typically hands-off during day-to-day execution but become highly involved and escalatory when issues arise. Successfully navigating these situations—through transparency, risk anticipation, sound judgment, and resolution under pressure—is a critical aspect of the role.
The role works closely with a small team of Android developers. The exact split of responsibilities will be defined once the new hire is onboarded, allowing flexibility based on individual strengths, experience, and evolving product and delivery needs.Responsibilities:Product & Backlog Management
Manage and maintain the product backlog in Jira, with a primary focus on accessibility-related bug
fixes, improvements, and release work
Support new accessibility features by preparing, refining, and tracking requirements and acceptance
criteria with stakeholder
Clarify functional, UX, and accessibility requirements with stakeholders and engineering
Ensure backlog items are well-defined, testable, and ready for implementation
Sprint, PI & Delivery Execution
Plan and facilitate sprint and PI activities with the development team
Coordinate sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and execution tracking
Monitor progress, dependencies, and risks across sprints and PIs
Sequence and balance work within agreed priorities and constraints to support timely delivery
Accessibility, Quality & Change Coordination
Coordinate defect fixes, accessibility improvements, and change requests
Assess and document impacts, dependencies, and delivery risks, especially where accessibility or
compliance may be affected
Highlight trade-offs and potential impacts early and transparently
Escalate complex or high-impact topics to the appropriate stakeholders
Release & Operational Ownership
Coordinate end-to-end release activities, including readiness tracking, validation status, and
communication
Support CI/CD, build, test, and deployment processes in collaboration with engineering
Track release quality, regression risks, and production issues
Coordinate verification activities on test benches and organize debugging sessions when required
Management of test specifications (update existing test specifications if required, create test runs for
external testers, etc.)
Stakeholder Communication
Represent the team and topic in stakeholder meetings, like calls with VW Group brands or
representatives of legal and regulatory departments
Act as the primary coordination point for day-to-day delivery and release topics
Communicate progress, risks, and release status clearly and consistently
Support alignment between product, UX, engineering, and validation stakeholders

Manter excelência no atendimento mesmo sob pressão.

title: Analista de ppcm sr
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).
Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.Principais atividades:
Acompanhar e controlar o plano de manutenção das linhas de produção, bem como realizar a programação de manutenções na Unidade Industrial;
Planejar as atividades da manutenção nas paradas programadas de fábrica, administrando a logística de materiais, ferramentas e serviços;
Indicar plano de ação e disponibilizar ferramentas e mão de obra, em casos de emergências, paradas de produção e/ou processo ou que impliquem em problemas nos aspectos de qualidade, segurança e meio ambiente;
Desenvolver em conjunto com a área Comercial, fornecedores com potencial tecnológico para aprimoramento do desempenho dos equipamentos e máquinas;
Adequar os planos preventivos de equipamentos existentes, após a análise das falhas repetitivas apresentada pela área de Engenharia, elaborando planos de ação para melhorias, em conjunto com a área de Engenharia de Manutenção;
Analisar criticamente os resultados das rotas de inspeção, informando de maneira clara os riscos em termos de segurança associados à manutenção, por meio da análise de registros das inspeções realizadas pela equipe de execução;
Controlar back log e custos da linha de modo a manter o orçamento definido;
Detalhar todas as atividades da parada mensal, definindo Caminho Crítico e atividades nos equipamentos para a estimativas mais de prazos, custos e recursos.Requisitos:
Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia, Tecnólogo ou áreas afins;
Conhecimento de área/linhas MDF e MDP;
Conhecimento em SAP módulo PM manutenção;
Conhecimento do pacote Office;
Conhecimento avançado da ferramenta MS Project;
Conhecimento de mecânica, lubrificação, elétrica e instrumentação;
Diferencial: inglês e espanhol intermediário.

Noções de solda para um eventual ajuste de bases e proteções de equipamentos e para manutenção de equipamentos transportadores.

Conhecimento em interpretação de manuais e desenhos técnicos de máquinas e equipamentos.

Conhecimento nas normas técnicas pertinentes às atividades exercidas.
Domínio nos procedimentos operacionais de montagem e desmontagem de equipamentos, como bombas, redutores, transportadores, elevadores, etc.
Conhecimento na operação de equipamentos de corte, como plasma, esmerilhadeira, policorte, maçarico e moto-esmeril.
